answer.new_information: NN, Inc. announced in late June 2026 that 47 new machine centers would be added to its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks, and that 100% of the new capacity is already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards. The record also carries a company target of US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026. Mismatches and limits: the announcement gives no capex, unit count in revenue terms, or award values, so the pre-sold claim cannot be sized; the US$80–90m is a 2026 business target, not a result or guidance revision; the US$485.5m revenue and US$47.9m earnings to 2028 are a third-party narrative projection, and the US$489.5m and US$48.3m figures are unnamed analysts' estimates reported as a rumour, so neither is company guidance and neither matches a stated period or definition; the Russell Microcap Value Index removal is reported by finance.yahoo.com itself and does not bear on any NVIDIA liquid-cooling question.
answer.reason: No catalog or stored questions exist to update, and the record moves no existing number. Its substance is a company announcement relayed by a media site, with no sized revenue, no capex, and a 2026 target rather than a result. The rest is promotional filler and third-party or rumoured valuation projections. It is context for a future question on NVIDIA-related liquid-cooling exposure and should be kept as background until a filing or customer disclosure sizes the awards.
